newsitem.title: USA: Disney plans ad campaign for videos - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Disney plans ad campaign for videos - WSJ.

text.p: Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista Home Video unit will embark on a $250-million advertizing blitz to promote its home videos like "Toy Story" for the holiday season, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.

The newspaper said the amount of money the unit was spending was a huge increase from the $75 million that it spent last year, describing it as the biggest home video campaign in the company's history.
It quoted Ann Daly, the unit's president, as saying Walt Disney's marketing partners like Eastman Kodak Co and General Mills Inc would pay for much of the $250 million.
